objective: Rebuild policyctl frontend from scratch with 'The Agent's Leash' design system, deploy to Cloudflare Pages, wire to Worker API, with full CI/CD pipeline

criteria.label: Design tokens migrated to v2
criteria.check: grep -q '2DD4BF' packages/design-system/src/tokens.css && echo 'PASS: teal brand token present' || echo 'FAIL: v2 tokens missing'

criteria.label: Pages wrangler.toml exists for web/
criteria.check: test -f web/wrangler.toml && echo 'PASS: web/wrangler.toml exists' || echo 'FAIL: missing'

tasks.desc: Migrate design tokens to v2 (teal-coral palette)
Create web/wrangler.toml for Cloudflare Pages deployment
Create CI workflow (ci.yml) — lint, typecheck, test, build
Create deploy workflow (deploy.yml) — build + deploy Pages + Worker
Update web/ app: unified routing (landing + docs + auth + dashboard)
Wire dashboard pages to real Worker API (replace mock data)

context_summary: Goal: Rebuild policyctl frontend from scratch. Iteration 0: Surveyed codebase. Cloudflare resources verified (D1, KV, Worker, Pages, AI, DO all ready; R2 needs Dashboard enablement). Design system v2 approved (teal-coral palette). Architecture: Firecrawl-style same-origin path routing. Auth: keep custom D1 + Turnstile, harden it. Starting with Phase 0: Foundation.
